method: Direct canonical Japanese authoring for each Chinese locale, followed by full own-pair semantic self-review of every string. No external translation service, other-pair reading or peer review.
coverage: All lesson/cluster titles, full explanatory/example paragraphs, application prompts, glossary terms and illustration alt texts.
semanticChecks: Cubicle exterior does not establish internal components, voltage or circuits; PAS remains the exact acronym.
Transformation, switching, breakers and disconnectors retain separate functions; no switching procedure or dead-circuit guarantee added.
Switch indication, extinguished lights, alternate feeds, live surroundings, residual charge and reenergization controls remain distinct.
Short circuits include single-phase/DC; earth faults differ from designed protective grounding and from generic leakage.
Alarms and protection operation do not locate or eliminate the cause.
Wire insertion is not material compatibility; terminal/tool/die specifications, retention and electrical performance remain separate.
One component ampacity does not determine whole-system conditions; no current limits invented.
Overhead communication/power classification is not inferred visually; moving boom/cargo-bed envelopes and voltage-dependent separation retain scope.
No-contact photos and cable covers do not authorize approach or contact; no separation distance invented.
Japanese road-use/occupation permissions remain distinct; time/place/action conditions and field protection are separately confirmed.
Road covering structures differ from barriers; no load capacity, passage approval, material restraint, visibility or noise clearance inferred.
